_comment: Presentation ladder (docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-03 'Visual progression', Steve: "Start simple, but it would be cool if as you progress, the game graphics and interface keep getting better and better."). A stage is reached when BOTH codex depth AND days survived meet its row: stages advance on Codex depth + days survived, never on timers. Read by src/js/presentation.js; app.js puts stage-N on <body>; tile-scenes.js blends the map palette from earthy (stage 0) to rich (stage 4). Thresholds are v1, provisional: tune here, not in code.
